_comment: TicTacToe locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side).

_slots.{symbol}: The player's mark, either X or O
_slots.{opponent_symbol}: The opponent's mark, either X or O
_slots.{cell}: A board cell number between 0 and 8

player_prompt.intro:
Inwe ni Nyathi {player_id} kwenye Tic Tac Toe.
Jukumu lako ni kuwinja michezo mitatu mfululizo (mbali, juu chini, au diagonally) kwenye ubao.
Katika zamu yako, inafaa uchague nambari ya mraba (0-8) ambayo unataka kuweka alama yako.
Kwa mfano, '[4]' itaweka alama yako kwenye seli ya katikati ya ubao.
Kama Nyathi {player_id}, utakuwa '{symbol}', wakati mpinzani wako ni '{opponent_symbol}'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Oketo chenro mar timo kamano e yo ma ok owinjore.
invalid_move.out_of_range: {cell} ok en cell maber. Nyaka obed e kind 0 kod 8.
invalid_move.already_occupied: Cell {cell} en gima osebed ka itiyo godo.

game_action.placed: Nyathi {player_id} ameweka alama yake ({symbol}) kwenye seli {cell}.
